sinopsis.es: Nunkui, una joven shuar, descubre su conexión con el espíritu femenino del huerto mientras su comunidad amazónica enfrenta el avance de la minería y los desalojos.
sinopsis.en: Nunkui, the female spirit of the garden. Nunkui, the name of a Shuar girl in a lush world of plants, animals, spirits and an extended family. Between premonitory dreams and mining conflicts in the Amazonian Cóndor mountain range, Nunkui searches for her place in the world, influenced by her grandfather Yaunchu, an old Shuar leader.
